craft_notes: Sthāyin: arrival-joy (aim done). Sanskrit first: four qualifications + arrival → L4 sets ripeness line 1, arrival line 2. Rows: row 8 (warm vowels trusting/spent/content). Rupture: comma after spent — ripeness held, arrival stated. Close: end-weight on contentment. Minimal pass: 'thinned and spent' for kṣīṇa (wasted sung gentle); 'aim content' for caritārtha (done-as-content). Read aloud: trusting, thinned, drunk, done. Rejected: 'ecstasy' for rata — killed: delighting kept (rata as joy, not rapture); 'immortality' for amṛta — killed: nectar kept (drinkable).

lines: Inner sense trusting, fancies thinned and spent,
self-form his joy, self-nectar-drunk — freedom, aim content.
l4.sanskrit_cite: āśvastāntaḥkaraṇaḥ kṣīṇavikalpaḥ svarūpalābharataḥ / svānubhavāmṛtatṛptaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti caritārthaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Inner sense trusting, fancies wasted, own-form delight, nectar-sated — he reaches freedom, aim done.
c1_essence: Sense at peace, nectar-sated: freedom reached, aim done.
